photos.desc: AKA Cantharellus tubaeformis (old name), yellowfoot, winter mushroom, funnel chanterelle, suppilovahvero (fin). Taken with Canon FD 50mm F3.5 Macro / Full Frame Sensor / Natural Light / Lightroom.
Fruitbodies in comparison: above Trumpet Chanterelle ( Craterellus tubaeformis ) and below Jellybaby ( Leotia lubrica )
Painting of mushrooms (from left to right Craterellus tubaeformis , a Lactarius of the deliciosus group, and a probable Pluteus ) by Annie L. Prat ( 1861 - 1960 ).
